lesson.title: Strumming in Time: Em, Am and D
objectives: Keep a steady down-strum on every beat without stopping
Add the 'and' upstrokes while the strumming arm keeps moving
Change chord on beat 1 without breaking the pulse
Use the metronome as the timekeeper, not your chord hand

chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Four down-strums per chord
exercises.purpose: Establish an unbroken quarter-note pulse before adding anything else.
exercises.coaching: Your strumming arm never stops. If the chord is not ready, strum the muted strings and catch up on the next bar.
exercises.qa_status: verified-by-theory-check-2026-08-08 (chord data verified; teaching quality reviewed by author)

exercises.name: Down-up eighths on one chord
exercises.purpose: Train the constant-motion arm so upstrokes fall between the clicks.

params.pattern: D U D U D U D U

exercises.coaching: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and out loud. Down on the number, up on the and.
exercises.qa_status: verified-by-theory-check-2026-08-08 (chord data verified; teaching quality reviewed by author)

exercises.name: Chord change on beat 1
exercises.purpose: Make the change land with the pulse instead of pausing the bar.

params.rule: Lift on beat 4, land on beat 1

exercises.coaching: Lift a hair early on beat four. An early lift is a clean landing; a late lift is a stumble.
exercises.qa_status: verified-by-theory-check-2026-08-08 (chord data verified; teaching quality reviewed by author)

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Timing beats tidiness. Today the metronome is in charge and your strumming arm keeps swinging no matter what your fingers do.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: Four down-strums per chord at sixty. Em, Am, D, around again.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Same tempo, now down-up. The arm moves the whole time; you only touch the strings when you mean to.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex3_intro: Change on beat one. Lift on four, land on one. Do not stop the bar to fix a finger.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: A steady bar with one buzzy chord beats a clean chord with a dead bar.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Constant motion, count out loud, change on one. That is the whole lesson.
